files.tests/test_negative_additions.py:
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import unittest


class NegativeAdditionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_negative_additions_do_not_reduce_a_total(self):
        total = runpy.run_path(str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src/app.py"))["stock_total"]
        for quantities in ([], [0], [2, 6], [-3, 2, 6]):
            with self.subTest(quantities=quantities):
                items = [{"quantity": value} for value in quantities]
                before = total(items)
                self.assertEqual(total(items + [{"quantity": -7}]), before)
